KG Beckumer Straße 33–35, 59229 Ahlen kaldewei.de / info@kaldewei.de +49 2382 785 0 Kaldewei Österreich GmbH Ottensheimer Straße 36, 4040 Linz kaldewei.de / info@kaldewei.de +49 2382 785 0 KALDEWEI Schweiz GmbH, Ahlen, Zweigniederlassung Aarau Rohrerstrasse 100, 5000 Aarau kaldewei.ch / info.schweiz@kaldewei.com +41 62 2052100 Honest luxury runs in circles. For more than 100 years, KALDEWEI has stood for superior bathroom products made of steel enamel. For us, the beauty of the product lies in high-quality materials in a perfect form. Our goal is to become a climate-neutral family business – so that we can leave a planet worth living in for future generations. That is why we call our sustainability report LUXSTAINABILITY®REPORT. Our bathroom products are made of steel enamel and stand for long-lasting quality with an exquisite surface. We continue to earn the trust of our partners, be- cause the high product quality of the steel enamel, resulting from decades of experience, makes it possible for us to offer a 30-year guarantee1.
